outcome: disease severity in bladder deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE)
cohort: The cohort consists of 107 nonpregnant women younger than 42 years with histologically proven bladder deep infiltrating endometriosis who had undergone complete surgical excision.
finding: A history of uterine surgery (scarred uterus) was observed in 14.9% of bladder DIE cases but was not related to an increased severity of the disease.
cross-section timing: Data collection occurred in the month preceding the surgery for endometriosis.
